scope: single non-executable retrospective diagnostic; 47 original MR40 entry signals, not a new entry filter, backtest or tuning sweep

preexisting_evidence.entry_time: signal 4h bar CLOSED j, trade scheduled at j+1 open

asof_descriptors.interpretation: bar volume relative to previous 30 closed bars; no future candles
OHLC signed candle activity proxy, NOT actual aggressor delta, order flow, CVD, L2 liquidity, or volume absorption

nontrading_hypothesis: Seller-activity exhaustion or continuation may show stable differences in pre-entry volume intensity between eventual MR40 winners and losers, measured before the entry; outcomes used for retrospective labeling only.
analysis_plan: On train (25 trades, 19 winners 6 losers) and evaluation (22 trades, 18 winners 4 losers), report medians and pairwise AUC (winner higher), exact two-sided rank label-permutation p with ties respected. Also list per-trade pre-entry values and labels. Never compute thresholds from these outcomes.
multiple_testing: Bonferroni 2 descriptors × 2 periods; alpha<=0.0125 for each test, and AUC direction must agree across periods to qualify for follow-up research. No selection if either period fails; any pass is still only historically seen and not a deployable filter.
gates: At most an independent future-only shadow hypothesis if stable and significant across both. No current backtest filter or Paper promote regardless. If no stability, reject historical discriminative claim; collect genuinely prospective Bybit or appropriately labeled research-only backup market feed after an as-of-locked protocol.
source_limitations: 2023–2026 candles and profits already examined; evaluation not pristine blind OOS
Bybit public APIs currently HTTP 403 on research laptop; no forward source has been verified
Historical 4h↔1m exact OHLC source-parity gate FAILED; historical volume quality not independently proven
OHLC signed-body-weighted-volume is not observed aggressor flow, liquidity, quote depth or order execution
